cache_counter_interpretation: hit/miss/compile/publication/eviction fields are per-sample deltas from cumulative counters. Resident entry/code/metadata values are high-water values; arena_available_slots_from_high_water is derived from capacity minus resident-entry high-water and is not live occupancy.
observer_effect_interpretation: paired observed/ordinary call ratios are the net difference between two full adapter-plus-dispatcher call paths, including PhaseRecorder work and any difference between generic instantiations; they are not a pure observer-cost estimate. No pure generated-code host-execution time, dispatcher-only total lookup time, or linking benefit is isolated.
phase_boundary_contract: warm hit-only phase inventory: block_build_and_admission; key_snapshot_and_initial_lookup (minimum sizing, TranslationKey construction, initial snapshot validation, first cache.find and hit/miss counter update only); host_execution_boundary (backend/arena checks, host context, generated entry and result decoding, not pure guest execution). Lowering/allocation/emission/publication phase calls must be zero after warmup. Phase call counts are checked against the full expected visit/block counts for each completed deterministic dispatch; an early exit fails reconciliation. PhaseRecorder end-phase/index work before its elapsed clock read is inside that phase; duration/call accumulation after the clock read is outside. The unattributed_adapter_dispatcher_ns residual also includes the second cache.find, cached snapshot and code-view revalidation, guards, accounting, other cache bookkeeping, adapter setup, and observer bookkeeping outside the phase clock samples.
timing_scope: sum of full Variant::call / Variant::call_observed adapter-plus-dispatcher intervals over one warmed FIFO(16) stratum; each interval includes CodeView, dependency and control/context setup performed by the adapter plus the complete dispatcher call. Case-state cloning/reset, full result/state validation, PhaseRecorder construction/reset and totals extraction are outside the interval. Ordinary and observed paths alternate on one shared warmed engine and arena; strata are never aggregated.
